title: T9 — Candidate solutions (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Candidate Solutions — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Candidates

| Candidate | Shape | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Eleven typed tables with 26 actions | explicit ADM rows: artifacts, entries, links, profile, contracts, reviews, waivers, board, maturity, skills | adopted |
| Artefacts as documents only | a published document per phase with no typed row | rejected: the gates need typed, approvable rows (§8.1, §10.3) |
| Free-text compliance | the review records a prose verdict | rejected: one level per review, enforced (`architecture_compliance.rs`) |
| Project-wide H enforcement | one change/kata for the whole project per review | limited: Phase H enforces per review, not project-wide (v1-p81-6) |
| Draft board governs | any board row may decide | open deviation: v1-p81-4 names it; not accepted as design |

## Criteria

The §12 T9 gate: each phase's artefacts approved before the next; a delivery design needs a
live contract; a compliance review records one level; a waiver names owner and review date; H
produces exactly one governed outcome. Secondary: typed links, tenant/project consistency, and
a board that is live before it decides.

## Options rejected

The document-only and free-text shapes would let a gate pass on prose, the exact defect the
V1 audit found (v1-p81-5). The draft-board acceptance is recorded as a deviation (v1-p81-4),
not as chosen design; the project-wide H reading is v1-p81-6, carried as work.
